summary: Guard-gated field reader over a per-object state struct a2: validates the caller pointer a1, the state pointer a2, an enable flag bit (byte at a2+8 bit 0x08), and the output pointer a3, then copies a 32-bit field at a2+16 into *a3 and a 16-bit field at a2+20 into *a4, returning 8 on success or 0 when any guard fails.

operations.description: Guard: return 0 when the first argument a1 is null.
Guard: return 0 when the state pointer a2 is null.
Guard: return 0 when the enable flag bit 0x08 in the byte at a2+8 is clear.
Guard: return 0 when the 32-bit output pointer a3 is null.
Store the 32-bit field at a2+16 into *a3.
Store the unsigned 16-bit field at a2+20 into *a4.
Return 8 to signal success; all guard failures return 0.

unresolved: a4 is dereferenced without a null guard while a3 is guarded; the caller must guarantee a4 is valid.
Meaning of the return value 8 and the enable bit 0x08 at a2+8 depend on the state object layout known only to caller sub_50210E.
Identity of the object behind a2 and the semantics of fields at a2+16 (32-bit) and a2+20 (16-bit) are not established.
